name: Wall High Knee
steps: Face a wall and place your palms against it at chest height.
Step your feet back until you lean forward from the ankles with your arms straight.
Brace your core firmly so your body forms a straight line from head to heels.
Drive one knee sharply upward toward your chest while pushing firmly off the ball of your opposite foot, then rapidly switch legs.
Continue alternating knees briskly in a continuous sprint-drive rhythm for the target duration.
tips: Keep your hips locked forward in line with your shoulders instead of letting your glutes drift backward.
Pull your toes up toward your shins on each rising knee to mimic crisp sprinting mechanics.
